summary: This dataset, UTHealth - Fundus and Synthetic OCT-A Dataset (UT-FSOCTA), contains 112 subjects with fundus images and en-face OCT-A images, which have been manually aligned for training medical imaging machine learning pipelines. The dataset includes 45 degree macula centered fundus images acquired using an OptoVue iVue fundus camera, en-face OCT-A images of the superficial capillary plexus acquired using an OptoVue Avanti OCT camera, and synthetic OCT-A images generated using a custom conditional generative adversarial network. The dataset also includes vessel segmentations from two recent algorithms, SA-Unet and IterNet, and is available in various directories, including fov45, cropped, and synthetic_octa.
